body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one enemy within 4 units. On a success against Composure, it gains +1 die on its next Action against you; if it uses that Action, it becomes Exposed afterward.

surges.html: If the target has any Condition, this Action ignores 1 Defense.
On a success, reduce the target's equipment-granted Defense by 1 until its next turn.

rider.title: GAMBIT CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The target ignores you and targets another creature. Effect: It becomes Exposed and suffers -1 Defense until its next turn.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
